QUOTE: The part before the first `:` is matched against the tool name. The part after it is matched against the argument value. ... `git.commit` | that tool, any args (no colon means tool name only) ... Matching is `pattern_matches` (`permission_manager.cpp:101`), which uses `fnmatch`

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, a split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a pattern with no colon matches the tool name only.
